verdict.rationale: Jira's integrations page claims first-party Trello–Jira syncing, so work from one other project management tool can be brought into Jira alongside native issues. Nothing shows a dedicated unified 'my assigned tasks' view across several tools. The 3,000+ Marketplace apps and Rovo's third-party data connections are adjacent or third-party capabilities and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented unified view of assigned tasks, aggregation from multiple external PM tools (Asana, Linear, etc.) beyond Trello, details of how synced Trello assignments appear in Jira views, and hands-on corroboration.
